thread:
mina: auditor (Grant Thornton) requested a compact package proving RBAC removals were effective after the Mar 15 change and that KMS rotations didn't leave accessible key material. They want a short narrative + hashed artifacts. Can someone own a minimal export and a one-paragraph statement?

jorge: I can own RBAC proof. Scope: prod + staging. I'll pull pre/post rolebinding snapshots and a small sample of `kubectl auth can-i` checks executed as the removed principals. ETA 30m.

kate: I'll pull KMS events around the rotation window and grep for any import/export calls. Command I'll run: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:UpdateCryptoKeyVersion OR protoPayload.methodName:ImportCryptoKeyVersion OR protoPayload.methodName:AsymmetricSign" --start-time=2026-03-15T03:00:00Z --end-time=2026-03-15T05:00:00Z`

sec-bot: evidence-checklist: RBAC pre/post YAML, rolebinding-diff.patch, sample `kubectl auth can-i` outputs (sanitized), KMS versions JSON + audit slice, SIEM correlation (SIEM-8001), vuln triage note, README-chain-of-custody.md, sha256 hashes of artifacts. Redact PII and customer ids. Retention: 7 years.

jorge: quick note: the change removed two service principals and rotated `svc-deployer` to a new name. I'll replace emails with `<REDACTED-SVC>` and stamp each file with who exported it.

ops-ella: SIEM slice pulled: SIEM-8001 correlates a failed decrypt attempt at 2026-03-15T03:12Z with rotate activity. Adding the SIEM snippet (redacted).

dev-ryan: vuln triage: SEC-4602 (tooling library) was patched prior to the change. Triage note attached in bundle, short summary: patch 3.4.1 applied to deployer pipeline, no residual exploit path.

jorge: assembled artifacts: rbacs_pre.yaml, rbacs_post.yaml, rbac-diff.patch, auth-checks.txt (sanitized), kms-versions.json, kms-audit-slice.log, siem-siem-8001.json, SEC-4602-triage.md, README-chainofcustody.md.

jorge: sample sanitized auth check included: `kubectl auth can-i get secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:prod:<REDACTED-SVC>` -> "no" (expected). Also included a smoke test: envelope decrypt check failing against old key version (sanitized).

kate: KMS export verified: only `UpdateCryptoKeyVersion` events present for rotation; no `ImportCryptoKeyVersion` or `CryptoKeyMaterialExport` calls. I added the exact grep commands to README.

sec-bot: please compute sha256 for each artifact and include in README.

jorge: computed and added sha256 values. Uploaded internal raw bundle to s3://redwood-internal-audit/grant-2026/evidence-1777778001/raw/ and auditor bundle (redacted + hashed) to s3://redwood-audit-deliverables/grant-2026/evidence-1777778001/auditor.zip

mina: include CI run id and PR permalink in README for traceability. CI id: `ci-20260315-7755`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/6012 (approver: mina).

auditor-paul: received link, thanks. Quick follow-up: can you show proof the revoked principals cannot perform decrypts via KMS (not just k8s)? i.e., an STS assume + KMS decrypt attempt returning AccessDenied.

ops-ella: added sanitized STS session logs showing `AssumeRole` prior to change and absence of subsequent successful `Decrypt` calls for those principals after rotation. Also included a sanitized `aws kms decrypt` attempt output that shows `AccessDenied` for the old principal.

auditor-paul: perfect. One more ask: short narrative paragraph we can include in control mapping.

mina: draft narrative: "On 2026-03-15 the ops team removed two service principals and renamed the deployer account as part of RBAC hygiene. The change was applied to prod and staging via PR #6012 (approver: mina), CI run ci-20260315-7755. Post-change verification included `kubectl auth can-i` checks, STS session log review, and KMS audit correlation (SIEM-8001). No CryptoKey export/import calls were observed; KMS rotation used version creation only. Artifacts (redacted) and sha256 hashes have been provided to the auditor."

auditor-paul: that wording works. Thanks for the fast turnaround. We'll review and reopen if we need additional samples.

sec-bot: ticket SEC-4602 flag -> evidence-submitted

jorge: DM'd auditor the s3 link and included README. Closing loop here. Thanks team :thumbsup:
